reviews.text: It's a great place and location; my Tita gets in very quickly when she arrives, and that tells me she likes being there.

A great place to take your dog when you don't have time to look after them or you're going on a trip. The staff is friendly and they seem to treat the dogs very well. Just be sure to book in advance because they're often fully booked.

My puppy always wants to go back. They feed her well, and it's a lovely place for her to socialize with other puppies. The staff is serious but very responsible and attentive. They always send me cute pictures of her. I highly recommend it.

Bruce has been going to daycare four times a week for about a year now, and I also leave him there for boarding when I travel. The service, attention, and care have been excellent; they always keep me updated with photos and videos. They have daily exercise circuits to keep the dogs active, and the facilities are in perfect condition. I highly recommend them, and Bruce does too!

It's a great doggy daycare. My dog ​​has been going there since they opened. She's super happy and gets so excited when she arrives.
They're very careful with baths and haircuts.

My dog ​​has been enrolled at this kennel for almost two years and is very happy. He goes twice a week and gets a bath once a month. He plays with other dogs his size and energy level and does his agility exercises.
As a dog mom, they write to me about how he's doing during the day, send me photos, and always ask my permission to give him food when another dog has a birthday.
It's important to mention that they don't have a yard, but it's always super clean (it doesn't smell of pee or poop).

The daycare and grooming services (which we know firsthand) are the best in the area. I know several colleagues and neighbors who take their pets to Doggies, and we all agree that it's a great place to trust that our furry friends are well cared for and entertained. Always recommended! Thank you, Doggies family!

You always return to where you're happy, and yes… Every week we go back to the doggies' daycare where they provide excellent care and entertainment, trusting in the work we do. During their stay, they send photos and videos of the agility training that our whole family enjoys. The bathing and grooming service is the best. Thank you so much, Doggies team!

His smile says it all. Excellent place :)
My son is a picky eater, and at Doggies they treat him well and pamper him like he's at home <3

Excellent place and service for your dogs, offering daycare and boarding. My dog ​​is happy; he jumps out of the car without looking back, a clear sign that he feels safe. All the staff are very friendly and attentive to the animals. 1000% recommended when you need to leave your pets.
